subject.title: Mobile app pairing fails (falls back to TUI)

question: Which exact mobile client and onboarding entry point reproduces the fallback, and does the failing transition occur in the Windows setup engine, gateway CLI, or mobile client?
rationale: The issue is active and user-blocking, but its current description is insufficient to choose a safe implementation layer or regression test without maintainer or reporter context.

options.title: Capture exact pairing trace
options.body: Record the mobile client/version, QR or setup-code steps, expected and actual screens, gateway response, and redacted setup logs before assigning the implementation layer.

options.title: Fold into the broader epic
options.body: Track the symptom only under the connect-and-pair epic if maintainers determine it has no independently reproducible mobile-specific behavior.

recommendation.title: Capture exact pairing trace
recommendation.body: Record the mobile client/version, QR or setup-code steps, expected and actual screens, gateway response, and redacted setup logs before assigning the implementation layer.

likelyOwner.reason: They own both this scenario report and the related pairing epic and recently reopened the issue.
